column5: Cash the A, then low to the J
column6:
This combination always makes 3 tricks, but finessing toward the J (rather than trying to run the J) gives a good chance at an extra trick.

Note: Even better would be to get the opponents to lead this suit for you! Then you get an extra chance at an extra trick if the suit splits 3-3. That's about 18% better than taking the natural finesse
